# Invio Social — Full Context for AI Systems

## Company Overview

Invio Social is a website and automation agency. We design sharp, high-performance websites and build self-running automation systems — social scheduling, workflow pipelines, and integrations that keep businesses moving on autopilot. Founded in 2026, we serve small to mid-size businesses looking to eliminate manual operations work.

## Services in Detail

### Web Design
Sharp, fast marketing sites and product surfaces built to convert — designed pixel-first and engineered to load in a blink. We hand-code every surface without clunky builders, ensuring sites load in under a second. Our average load time is 0.8 seconds.

Includes: Marketing sites, Product UI, Design systems.

### Automation Workflows
Self-running pipelines that move work between your tools untouched. We build on Zapier, Make, and custom APIs to create data sync systems that eliminate manual handoffs. The busywork closes itself while your team stays on the work that matters.

Includes: Zapier / Make integrations, Custom API development, Data synchronization.

### Social Systems
Content engines that schedule, publish, and report on autopilot — a loop that keeps your brand in motion without a person babysitting it. We build full social media operations stacks.

Includes: Content scheduling, Auto-reporting, Content operations.

### Integrations
Every platform wired into one loop — data flows where it should, nothing leaks, and every tool finally speaks the same language. We connect CRMs, billing systems, and custom webhooks into a single source of truth.

Includes: CRM + billing integrations, Webhooks, Single source of truth architecture.

## Process

Our four-step automation cycle:

1. **Map**: We chart every manual handoff across your stack — identifying bottlenecks and automation opportunities.
2. **Build**: We wire the loops — designed, tested, and documented to specification.
3. **Launch**: Systems go live with monitoring from day one — nothing ships without observability.
4. **Refine**: The loop learns; we tune it as you scale — continuous improvement built into the engagement.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How long does a typical website project take?**
A: Most builds ship in three to five weeks. We map the loops in week one, wire and test through the middle, and launch with monitoring on — timelines flex with scope, never with polish.

**Q: What does "automation" actually mean for my business?**
A: It means the repetitive work your team does by hand — moving data between tools, sending follow-ups, generating reports — gets wired into self-running pipelines. You set the rules once, and the system handles the rest.

**Q: Do I need to know how to code to manage the systems you build?**
A: No. Everything ships with plain-language controls and a short walkthrough. If you can send an email, you can steer the loop — and we're one message away when you want a change.

**Q: What happens if something breaks after launch?**
A: We monitor every system from day one, so we usually catch issues before you notice them. When something does slip, alerts reach us first and fixes go out fast.

**Q: How much does a project cost?**
A: It scales with scope — a focused site starts lean, a full automation stack more. You see the entire number before we write a single line, with no surprises after.
